description: Run UI5 linter on a UI5 project to find and optionally fix UI5 related problems like the usage of deprecated API. After making changes, you should always run the linter again to verify that no new problems have been introduced.

filePatterns.description: File paths or patterns to lint. If not provided, all files in the project will be linted.

fix.description: Attempt to automatically correct certain findings in the files. Only the remaining findings will be returned.

projectDir.description: Root directory of the UI5 project to analyze. Must be an absolute path. Typically this the directory where the 'package.json' and 'ui5.yaml' files are located.

provideContextInformation.description: Whether to include supplementary information in the output. This includes UI5 API reference and documentation resources. When calling the tool multiple times for the same file or project, refrain from requesting additional context every time.

name: run_ui5_linter

apiReferences.description: Short extracts from the UI5 API reference for the APIs mentioned in the linter report

documentationResources.description: Relevant pages in the UI5 documentation that may help to understand the findings and how to resolve them best.

migrationGuides.description: For problems the linter can't fix automatically, "fix hint" documents may be provided as guidance for manually resolving them.

ruleDescriptions.description: Brief descriptions of the rules that were found to be violated in the project

frameworkVersion.description: The version of UI5 used in the project

items.description: Linting results for a single file in the project
